messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: Pager | service=continuous-batching severity=P2 - Latency P95 spike and 5xx increase at high concurrency. Links: https://telemetry/redwood/alerts/1799994321

alex: saw the alert, joining. which fleet/region?

jean: us-west-2 cb-runtime pool-12. spikes started ~1799994300, correlates with a prefetch heuristic change rolled 3h ago. KV cache eviction rate x10, queue depth rising.

miguel: confirmed from runtime side: KV cache size oscillating, microbatch sizes growing to ~256 occasionally, then immediate evictions -> backpressure. suspect prefetch window + adaptive batching interaction.

alex: any customer-facing errors?

emma: Support shows ~7 customers with increased tail latency, 3 with >1% 5xx (AcmeInc, NimbusAI, Shopperly). PMs notified. No critical SLA breach yet but latency SLOs impacted.

jean: quick snapshot: ```
p95_latency: 420ms -> 2.8s
inflight_queue: 120 -> 900
kvcache_evictions/s: 12 -> 130
microbatch_avg: 48 -> 189
```

miguel: repro steps locally with concurrency=120 shows similar: microbatch jitter every 30-90s. I can push a safe hotfix: rollback prefetch tweak or cap microbatch max to 64. Which is lower risk?

alex: prefer minimal surface: cap microbatch max and enable strict KV cache backpressure to avoid evictions. rollback prefetch is more invasive.

jean: agreed. plan: patch config -> set CB_MAX_MICROBATCH=64 and KV_PREFETCH_LIMIT=0.8 (temporary) on pool-12. Gradual rollout to 25% then 100% if metrics recover.

miguel: prepping patch now, will deploy via canary job.

alex: notify customers and start mitigation. I'll stay on until handoff. Sam, FYI for overnight.

emma: sending short note to affected customers that we are mitigating and will follow up with RCA.

deploy-bot: starting rollout: continuous-batching/pool-12 config update (canary=25%) - run_id=deploy-1799994321-01

miguel: canary up. monitoring p95 and evictions.

jean: canary metrics after 90s: p95 -> 520ms (from 2.8s), evictions down 60%, inflight queue reduced 40%. looks promising.

emma: customers pinged with mitigation update. no escalations yet.

deploy-bot: canary success. promoting to 100% - run_id=deploy-1799994321-02

miguel: 100% rolled. keeping close eye.

jean: 5m post-rollout: p95 460ms, evictions near baseline, microbatch_avg ~50. queue stable.

alex: great. logging followups: create incident ticket, capture timelines, include telemetry and config diff.

emma: opening customer follow-up thread and will coordinate communications.

miguel: leaving a note: root cause hypothesis - prefetch heuristic increased speculative prefetching under high concurrency, interacted badly with adaptive batching resulting in large microbatches and KV churn. Hotfix caps microbatch and temp-restricts prefetch.

jean: RCA + long-term mitigation: add guardrail that prevents microbatch growth above 128 when inflight queue>threshold; improve prefetch backoff under KV pressure; add regression test for high-concurrency jitter.

alex: handing off to Sam (night oncall). Summary: incident mitigated by config cap; monitors returning to normal; followups: RCA, config rollout to other pools, regression tests, customer comms. See runbooks linked.

sam: taking over. thanks all. will monitor next 2 hours and escalate if anything flares. :thumbsup:

alex: thanks team, marking as mitigated. will add notes to incident ticket.

pagerbot: Incident 1799994321 status=mitigated responder=alex,seamiguel,jean,emma timestamp=1799994398
